run_main_download_multinli: run the script to download and extract the MultiNLI 1.0 dataset from NYU
run_main_tokenize_multinli: run the script to tokenize MultiNLI dataset sentences using spaCy and save tokenized JSONL files
refactor_main_use_custom_spacy_model: refactor main to accept a custom spaCy model name instead of hardcoded 'en'
refactor_main_avoid_os_system: refactor main to use Python subprocess instead of os.system for wget and unzip
review_main_jsonl_processing: review main to understand how it reads JSONL files and writes tokenized output with tqdm progress
